person.title: Software Engineer | Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
person.summary: Software Engineer specializing in multi-tenant backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps automation. Proven experience in designing scalable microservices, implementing GitOps delivery pipelines, and managing containerized environments. Passionate about automating server setups, observability, and integrating AI coding assistants into modern development workflows.

legaliox.title: Lead Backend Engineer & DevOps Infrastructure Lead
points: Lead the backend of Legaliox, a multi-tenant legal SaaS platform.
Design and build the API and its business logic for every tenant.
Run the DevOps infrastructure the platform is built, shipped and hosted on.

points: Built an AI-powered agent that analyzes resumes.

badass.name: BADASS Network Architecture
badass.description: A data-center network design: VXLAN overlays with a BGP EVPN control plane, routed with FRRouting.

cloud1.name: Cloud-1 Automation
cloud1.description: Automated deployment of a WordPress and MariaDB stack on AWS: Terraform provisions the infrastructure and Ansible configures the host.

iot.name: Inception-of-Things
iot.description: Kubernetes from the ground up: K3s clusters on Vagrant VMs, Traefik ingress with host-based routing, then K3d with Argo CD deploying from Git.

portfolio.name: Interactive 3D Portfolio
portfolio.description: This site: React with React Three Fiber scenes sharing one WebGL canvas, a canvas wave background and Tailwind design tokens.

cub3d.name: cub3D
cub3d.description: A first-person maze drawn by raycasting, in C with MLX42 (42 pair project): textured walls per side, doors, a minimap and mouse look.

fdf.name: FdF
fdf.description: A heightmap drawn as a wireframe in isometric projection, in C with MiniLibX (42 project), with keys to move, zoom, rotate and change the height.
